requirements.description: User wants the unit located near parks. Per the 'near' rule, the threshold is the 75th percentile of the green distribution (74.26), rounded to 74.

The user explicitly requires at least 115 sqm of gross floor area. The 15-person capacity is not converted to an area threshold because no verified gross-area threshold was supplied by the RegulatoryAgent. The Turin location is handled by the Location Agent, and the energy class preference is outside the REFERENCE COLUMNS.
User prefers a property in energy class D or better, so the energy class must be D, C, B, or any A class.

output.explanation: Selects commercial-type properties (Attività commerciali e assimilabili) with surface_area >= 115 sqm, energy class A1–D, and green score >= 74, within 3.0 km of the supplied coordinates (45.0677551, 7.6824892). Results are ordered by haversine distance ascending. The Turin place name is not used as a predicate, since comune_code is a cadastral identifier.
